```json
        "contents": "2. Look for the install icon (➕) in the address bar\n3. Click \"Install\" in the prompt\n4. App appears in your applications menu\n\n#### iOS (Safari)\n1. Visit https://tiimi.cz in Safari\n2. Tap the Share button (box with arrow)\n3. Scroll down and tap \"Add to Home Screen\"\n4. Tap \"Add\"\n\n#### Android (Chrome, Edge)\n1. Visit https://tiimi.cz\n2. Tap the menu (⋮) in the top right\n3. Tap \"Install app\" or \"Add to Home Screen\"\n4. Tap \"Install\"\n\n## Development\n\n### Building the App\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Build for production (generates service worker)\npnpm build\n\n# Start production server\npnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Important:** The PWA build uses **webpack** instead of Turbopack because &#96;@ducanh2912/next-pwa&#96; doesn't support Turbopack yet. This is configured in &#96;package.json&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n\"dev:next\": \"next dev --webpack\",\n\"build\": \"next build --webpack\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nBoth development and production builds will use webpack to ensure the service worker is generated correctly.\n\n### Testing PWA Locally\n\n1. Build the app: &#96;pnpm build&#96;\n2. Start production server: &#96;pnpm start&#96;\n3. Open Chrome DevTools → Application → Service Workers\n4. Verify service worker is registered\n5. Check manifest in Application → Manifest\n\n### Updating Icons\n\nIf you want to change the app icon:\n\n1. Edit &#96;public/icon.svg&#96; with your new design\n2. Run the icon generation script:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   node scripts/generate-pwa-icons.js\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n3. Follow the instructions to regenerate PNG icons\n4. Rebuild the app\n\n## Configuration\n\n### Manifest Settings\n\nLocated in &#96;public/manifest.json&#96;:\n\n- **App Name:** \"Tappka - Tiimiakatemia\"\n- **Short Name:** \"Tappka\"\n- **Theme Color:** #b31b1b (TAP Red)\n- **Background Color:** #fcfff7 (TAP White)\n- **Display:** standalone (no browser UI)\n- **Scope:** / (entire app)\n\n### Service Worker Caching\n\nThe service worker automatically caches:\n\n- Static assets (JS, CSS, fonts) - Cache First\n- Images - Stale While Revalidate\n- Google Fonts - Cache First\n- API routes - Network First\n- Pages - Network First\n\n## Future Enhancements",

        "contents": "# Tappka\n\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\n\n## Features\n\n- [ ] Authentication\n- [ ] Room booking\n- [ ] Essay Bank\n\n# Links\n\n## Publicly available\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\n\n## Locally available when running the project\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\n\n## Other links\n\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.comorg/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\n\n# Language\n\nThe project is written in english and will be written in english for better llm compatibility.\nAll czech should be just in localization files.\n\n# Local Development\n\n## Setup\n\n1. Install git if already not installed - https://git-scm.com/install/\n2. Install docker if already not installed - https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/\n2. Install node.js v24.x with pnpm 10.x if already not installed - https://nodejs.org/en/download/\n3. Install pnpm v10.x if you didn't choose it in the previous step\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g pnpm@10.28.1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Clone the repository \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit clone https://github.com/tappka/tappka.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n5. Navigate to the project directory - \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd tappka\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Running the project after setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm install\npnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe project will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)\n\n\n# Supabase\n\nSupabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\nSupabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",

        "contents": "[db.migrations]\n# If disabled, migrations will be skipped during a db push or reset.\nenabled = true\n# Specifies an ordered list of schema files that describe your database.\n# Supports glob patterns relative to supabase directory: \"./schemas/*.sql\"\nschema_paths = []\n\n[db.seed]\n# If enabled, seeds the database after migrations during a db reset.\nenabled = true\n# Specifies an ordered list of seed files to load during db reset.\n# Supports glob patterns relative to supabase directory: \"./seeds/*.sql\"\nsql_paths = [\"./seed.sql\"]\n\n[db.network_restrictions]\n# Enable management of network restrictions.\nenabled = false\n# List of IPv4 CIDR blocks allowed to connect to the database.\n# Defaults to allow all IPv4 connections. Set empty array to block all IPs.\nallowed_cidrs = [\"0.0.0.0/0\"]\n# List of IPv6 CIDR blocks allowed to connect to the database.\n# Defaults to allow all IPv6 connections. Set empty array to block all IPs.\nallowed_cidrs_v6 = [\"::/0\"]\n\n[realtime]\nenabled = true\n# Bind realtime via either IPv4 or IPv6. (default: IPv4)\n# ip_version = \"IPv6\"\n# The maximum length in bytes of HTTP request headers.         "contents": "# Force log out if the user has been inactive longer than the specified duration.\n# inactivity_timeout = \"8h\"\n\n# This hook runs before a new user is created and allows developers to reject the request based on the incoming user object.\n[auth.hook.before_user_created]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/before_user_created_hook\"\n\n# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n# [auth.hook.custom_access_token]\n# enabled = true\n# uri = \"pg-functions://&lt;database&gt;/&lt;schema&gt;/&lt;hook_name&gt;\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git.         "contents": "-- Tappka Reservation System Migration\n-- Creates tables for rooms, reservations, recurring schedules, cowork participants, room issues, and schedule breaks\n\n-- ============================================\n-- EXTENSIONS\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Required for EXCLUDE constraint (preventing overlapping reservations)\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;\n\n-- ============================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Reservation types\nCREATE TYPE reservation_type AS ENUM ('personal', 'training_session', 'houston_calling');\n\n-- Issue types for room problems\nCREATE TYPE issue_type AS ENUM ('locked', 'mess', 'technical', 'other');\nCREATE TYPE issue_status AS ENUM ('open', 'resolved');\n\n-- Schedule break types (Days of Joy, holidays, etc.)\nCREATE TYPE schedule_break_type AS ENUM ('days_of_joy', 'holiday', 'other');\n\n-- ============================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Rooms table\n-- Stores all reservable rooms with their rules\nCREATE TABLE rooms (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,          -- 'd126', 'd132', etc. (used in URLs)\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 'D126', 'Tichá místnost', etc.\n    description TEXT,                    -- Optional description\n    available_days INTEGER[],            -- NULL = all days, [3] = Wednesday only (0=Sun, 1=Mon, etc.)\n    can_have_ts BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,  -- Can have Training Sessions?\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Recurring schedules table\n-- Stores recurring Training Session schedules set by coaches\nCREATE TABLE recurring_schedules (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),",

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website. Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used\n# in emails.\nsite_url = \"http://localhost:3000\"\n# A list of *exact* URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.\nadditional_redirect_urls = [\n  \"http://localhost:3000/auth/callback\",\n  \"http://localhost:3000/auth/confirm-email-change\",\n]\n# How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 (1 week).\njwt_expiry = 3600\n# JWT issuer URL. If not set, defaults to the local API URL (http://127.0.0.1:&lt;port&gt;/auth/v1).\n# jwt_issuer = \"\"\n# Path to JWT signing key. DO NOT commit your signing keys file to git.\n# signing_keys_path = \"./signing_keys.json\"\n# If disabled, the refresh token will never expire.\nenable_refresh_token_rotation = true\n# Allows refresh tokens to be reused after expiry, up to the specified interval in seconds.\n# Requires enable_refresh_token_rotation = true.\nrefresh_token_reuse_interval = 10\n# Allow/disallow new user signups to your project.\nenable_signup = true\n# Allow/disallow anonymous sign-ins to your project.",

github.event.inputs.environment == 'preview')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}\n      PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.SUPABASE_PREVIEW_PROJECT_ID }}\n      \n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1\n        with:\n          version: latest\n          \n      - name: Link Supabase project\n        run: |\n          supabase link --project-ref $PROJECT_ID\n          \n      - name: Deploy database migrations\n        run: |\n          supabase db push || (supabase db reset --linked --yes &amp;&amp; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Functions...\"\n            supabase functions deploy\n          else\n            echo \"No Edge Functions found, skipping deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Function secrets\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -f \"supabase/.env.secrets\" ];     {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 69
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 82,
            "column": 252
          }
        },
        "contents": "Supabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.\n\nIn case there is a conflict on the preview branch, the github action will reset the database and push the changes again. Therefore **do not store anything important in the preview database**.\n\n# Recommended Tools\n\nIt is very nice to setup mcp with cursor for supabase. Look at [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323) and go to the top for connection button. It will give you the option.\nThere are cursor rules made for this nextjs project.\n\n# Publishing the project to the public\n\nYou can simply **push to the preview branch** and it will be deployed to the preview environment.\nFor production you will need to make a **pull request to the production branch** and it will be deployed to the production environment. You can approve it yourself, it's just for protection so that you don't accidentally deploy something to production.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "Supabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "Make sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "In case there is a conflict on the preview branch, the github action will reset the database and push the changes again. Therefore **do not store anything important in the preview database**.",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "# Recommended Tools",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "It is very nice to setup mcp with cursor for supabase. Look at [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323) and go to the top for connection button. It will give you the option.",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "There are cursor rules made for this nextjs project.",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "# Publishing the project to the public",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "You can simply **push to the preview branch** and it will be deployed to the preview environment.",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "For production you will need to make a **pull request to the production branch** and it will be deployed to the production environment. You can approve it yourself, it's just for protection so that you don't accidentally deploy something to production.",
            "lineNumber": 83
          }
        ]
      },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 193
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 254
          }
        },
        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_email ON pre_registered_emails(email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_claimed_by ON pre_registered_emails(claimed_by);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_user_id ON verification_codes(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_school_email ON verification_codes(school_email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_expires_at ON verification_codes(expires_at);\n\n-- Function to handle new user signup\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, team_id, is_verified, locale, created_at, updated_at)\n    VALUES (\n        NEW.id,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n        COALESCE((NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role')::user_role, 'student'),\n        CASE \n            WHEN NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id' IS NOT NULL \n            THEN (NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id')::UUID \n            ELSE NULL \n        END,\n        FALSE,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'locale', 'cs'),\n        NOW(),\n        NOW()\n    );\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- Trigger to create profile on user signup\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n    AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n\n-- Function to update updated_at timestamp\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    NEW.updated_at = NOW();\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\n-- Trigger to auto-update updated_at on profiles\nCREATE TRIGGER update_profiles_updated_at\n    BEFORE UPDATE ON profiles\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();\n\n-- Row Level Security (RLS) Policies\n\n-- Enable RLS on all tables\nALTER TABLE teams ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE pre_registered_emails ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE verification_codes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;",
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="unknown" data-tool-name="mcp-supabase-user-supabase-apply_migration">
<details>
<summary>Tool use: **mcp-supabase-user-supabase-apply_migration**</summary>


Parameters:

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "apply_migration",
      "parameters": "{\"name\":\"reinstall_btree_gist_to_extensions_schema\",\"query\":\"-- Migration: Reinstall btree_gist extension to extensions schema\\n-- Purpose: Move btree_gist from public schema to extensions schema for better organization\\n-- Affected: btree_gist extension, reservations.no_overlap constraint\\n\\n-- ============================================\\n-- EXTENSIONS SCHEMA SETUP\\n-- ============================================\\n\\n-- Ensure the extensions schema exists\\n-- This schema is used by Supabase for extension management\\nCREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS extensions;\\n\\n-- ============================================\\n-- DROP DEPENDENT OBJECTS\\n-- ============================================\\n\\n-- Drop the EXCLUDE constraint that depends on btree_gist\\n-- This constraint prevents overlapping active reservations for the same room\\n-- We will recreate it after reinstalling the extension\\nALTER TABLE IF EXISTS reservations DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS no_overlap;\\n\\n-- ============================================\\n-- REINSTALL BTREE_GIST EXTENSION\\n-- ============================================\\n\\n-- Drop the extension from public schema if it exists\\n-- This will remove all objects created by the extension from public schema\\nDROP EXTENSION IF EXISTS btree_gist CASCADE;\\n\\n-- Install the extension in the extensions schema\\n-- This extension provides support for indexing common datatypes in GiST\\n-- Required for EXCLUDE constraints (preventing overlapping reservations)\\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist SCHEMA extensions;\\n\\n-- ============================================\\n-- RECREATE DEPENDENT OBJECTS\\n-- ============================================\\n\\n-- Recreate the EXCLUDE constraint that prevents overlapping active reservations\\n-- This constraint uses GiST indexes provided by btree_gist extension\\nALTER TABLE IF EXISTS reservations\\nADD CONSTRAINT no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (\\n    room_id WITH =,\\n    tstzrange(start_time, end_time) WITH &amp;&amp;\\n) WHERE (status = 'active');\"}",
      "serverName": "supabase"
    }
  ]
}
```
